:::{#thm-entropy-sum-decomposition}
#### Decomposition of the sum of entropies

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),

$$\entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} = \entropyf{X \mid Y} + 2 \, \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Rearranging @thm-mutual-information-joint-minus-conditionals gives

$$\entropyf{X, Y} = \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}.$$

Rearranging @def-mutual-information gives

$$\entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} = \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{X, Y}.$$

Substituting the first display into the second gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y}
&= \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \sb{\mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}} \\
&= \entropyf{X \mid Y} + 2 \, \mutinfof{X}{Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
